correctness.rationale: The normalized resource update, positive-fitness type-II replicator formula, and linearization were reconstructed from equations (1)-(16) of the motivating manuscript. On the invariant x=0 face, the two resource-cycle points (A+1 ± sqrt((A-3)(A+1)))/(2A) exchange under the logistic map; the return derivative is -A^2+2A+4 in (-1,1). The transverse one-step derivative is S(n)>0, so the exact two-step multiplier equals S(n-)S(n+) and factors as the squared mean payoff minus the payoff-slope squared times two-point resource variance. At A=16/5 and m=403/400, the exact multipliers 37321/40000 and 4/25 are both inside the unit disk while mean-game multiplier 403/400 exceeds one. The nonnegative logistic update is uniformly <=4761/5120<1 on the biological square, and all payoffs are positive, proving physical invariance. The embedded Python/SymPy checker independently reconstructs every symbolic identity and checks 42 nearby forward trajectories. Numerical sampling is not used to prove infinite-time stability. Equality at transverse unit multiplier is explicitly unclassified.

value.rationale: The source explicitly proposes mean-game predictions of stability for periodic resource dynamics. The exact model-specific transverse multiplier changes an ecologically important prediction: invasion by a rare cooperator under the positive average payoff can nevertheless decay because its instantaneous multiplicative fitness is correlated with resource phase. The sharp open interval 1<m<sqrt(277)/16 and exact physical rational witness distinguish real attracting resource-supported defection from mean-game-repelling predictions. This is a motivated phase-boundary result, not a numerical table recomputation, a tiny parameter change, or merely a restatement of general Floquet theory.
